extracted.name: Pear and Gorgonzola Cheese Pizza
extracted.description: This easy Gorgonzola pizza is topped with slices of sweet and juicy fresh pear to make a unique cheese pizza with a delicious flavor combination.
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) package refrigerated pizza crust dough
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Place pizza crust dough on a medium baking sheet. Layer with Provolone cheese. Top cheese with Bosc pear slices. Sprinkle with walnuts and Gorgonzola cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven 8 to 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and crust is lightly browned. Remove from heat. Top with chives and slice to serve.
